Metadata.description: Winery tastings, vineyard tours and wine trips in Italy. Pick your date and book online.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The address may have changed or no longer exists. Head back home or browse our experiences.

hero.title: Wine is best understood where it's born
hero.intro: Winery tastings, days among the vines and multi-day trips through Italy's wine country. Pick your date and book online.
hero.regions: Langhe, Valpolicella, Chianti Classico, the Prosecco hills, Franciacorta and Etna

durations.title: How much time do you have?
durations.intro: From an afternoon tasting to a week-long journey: choose based on how much time you want to give to wine.

choose.title: Choose date and guests
choose.description: Every experience shows its available dates and works out the price for your group before you book.

confirm.title: Instant or on-request confirmation
confirm.description: Many experiences are confirmed right away. For the others, we check availability with the winery and reply by email.

pay.title: Pay online
pay.description: With instant confirmation you pay at booking. For requests you pay nothing until we confirm: we'll send you the payment link.

map.title: The world's wine regions
map.intro: Pick a country: the number shows the experiences on offer. The other great wine regions are already on the map, waiting for upcoming trips.

hours.title: Winery experiences
hours.description: Guided tastings, masterclasses and family harvests, with the people who make wine every day.

day.title: Vineyard tours
day.description: By e-bike, Vespa or with a private driver: several wineries in one day, with lunch and tastings along the way.

days.title: Wine trips
days.description: Weekends and itineraries with overnight stays among the vines, in small groups on fixed dates or tailor-made.
